description: Defines the 'Station' class representing a network station (client or backhaul) with associated properties, capabilities, and statistics within the prplMesh controller database.

classes.name: Station
classes.description: Represents a network station (client or backhaul) with properties, capabilities, and statistics, including methods for managing BSS, RSSI, and other station-specific data.

methods.name: assign_client_locating_task_id
methods.description: Assigns a task ID for client locating, based on connection status.

methods.name: get_client_locating_task_id
methods.description: Retrieves the task ID for client locating, based on connection status.

methods.name: get_beacon_measurement
methods.description: Retrieves beacon measurement data (RCPI and RSNI) for a specified AP MAC.

methods.name: set_beacon_measurement
methods.description: Sets beacon measurement data (RCPI and RSNI) for a specified AP MAC.

methods.name: get_cross_rx_rssi
methods.description: Retrieves cross-RSSI data for a specified AP MAC.

methods.name: set_cross_rx_rssi
methods.description: Sets cross-RSSI data for a specified AP MAC.

methods.name: set_bss
methods.description: Sets the BSS information for the station.

methods.name: is_bSta
methods.description: Checks if the station is a backhaul station.

methods.name: set_bSta
methods.description: Sets whether the station is a backhaul station.

methods.name: set_eth_switch
methods.description: Associates an Ethernet switch with the station.
